live_issue_scopes.title: Save and reopen arranged weeks in the offline studio
live_issue_scopes.body:
## Offline arranged-week files — estate-81ba1ed0179c

The received offline studio can move or omit the recorded suggestions and choose a dated week, but its only JSON download retains the original native record. Reloading cannot restore the arranged handoff. Add explicit **Save week → Open saved week → Preview → Replace displayed week** to this existing offline surface.

Current main is **9930c0a18f339ca00bb7c43b4defd5b0d61ae56c**, tree **e3e3e48675f9f4ce1f5c139ad24f8c1c640f01dd**. All 54 previously received offline blobs still match PR18. Current project issues, HAMON140's latest 127 comments and native exact-namespace records were read; no other offline-week claimant was found. This is a new external product contribution, not a replay or assignment of the original failed native goal.

## Exact source boundary

Only **`web-demo-offline/`**: copy the already accepted `static/week_file.mjs` codec exactly (blob `420ddb8f63fca264dcf97be7147801105696155d`), add a narrow offline record-binding/file-preview module, scoped app/index/style hooks, focused tests/browser receiving and updated package/instructions/provenance. The codec's `week_plan.mjs` dependency already matches the offline copy exactly (`8ed28163e0273c510fdd8e6f7c5d1c8476efb862`).

The existing saved-week-v1 format and shared codec are unchanged. A file is accepted by the offline surface only after the existing codec validates it **and** its complete source response and original profile inputs match one of this studio's 24 pinned native records. Unsupported or altered source data must not become a new recorded plan. The preview identifies the profile, constraints, saved date and proposed arrangement; application is explicit. Current edits survive refusal or cancellation, and a newer selection, changed plan/arrangement, or cancellation retires unfinished reads and previews. File reads are bounded and strict UTF-8.

Saving retains the full original response, explanations, comparison and trace plus the chosen week and every assignment/omission. Reopening reconstructs the native immutable week state and preserves the same finite-record and synthetic-source labels. It performs no fresh planning or source-check recapture. No automatic browser storage, upload, account or calendar action is added.

## Preserved owners

All shared `static/`, backend/client/model/constraint source, calendar, local-draft storage, venue worksheet #16 and low-sodium #22 work remain with their existing owners. The accepted source format is reused without changing its schema or parser. No existing owner branch, installed service, native goal/lease or workflow is modified.

## Receiving

Isolated Mac worktree: `/tmp/tastetable-offline-81ba1ed0179c/weekly-files`, branch `estate-81ba1ed0179c/tastetable-offline-week`, based on the exact prior native contribution `0d34015db22507b595c1979aeb54209c90ba4741`. Publication will preserve the then-current complete main tree.

Retain an actual unchanged-browser arrangement/reload and source-only-download witness. Qualify the reused codec against all 24 records, current-week save/open equality, all-omitted and date-boundary weeks, exact fixture binding, incompatible/altered/oversized/invalid-UTF8 refusal, stale read/preview retirement, keyboard and phone controls, actual completed downloads and print provenance. Preserve original receipts; independently receive the frozen candidate and pass ordinary exact-head CI before integration.

live_issue_scopes.title: Prepare venue questions and record replies in the caregiver week handoff
live_issue_scopes.body:
## Caregiver venue contact worksheet — estate-6c20bb4b010e / optimizer_capability

TasteTable's current README asks caregivers to confirm food and accessibility needs with venues and the care team. The received week at main `f04353ffe4de808543031f56a2a59fac589cb0ab` (tree `54925099a2014aa43c79092f3b692060cf6216d4`, app blob `1709ed872442b10e17f8a85491cc92526db361a0`) can arrange, print and export recommendations, but has no place to prepare venue questions or retain a user-entered reply during that planning visit.

Add a venue contact worksheet for each scheduled occurrence: retain the original check reason, offer an editable question, record contact state and the caregiver's own reply or follow-up note, and include the clearly labeled worksheet in the existing print handoff. A reply is user-entered planning information; it does not change the original checks or produce a safety, availability or booking verdict.

### Exact source scope

New `static/venue_followup.mjs`, `static/venue_followup.css`, focused native Node/browser controls and unique documentation/evidence. Shared changes are limited to composable app/index hooks for accepted-plan binding, schedule refresh, retirement on plan invalidation and print output. Existing backend checks, provider/model calls, calendar writer, week model, saved-week format and storage remain unchanged.

The worksheet binds to the accepted source and individual current occurrences, including repeated venue IDs. Schedule changes must not relabel an earlier reply as current for a different occurrence or date. State is local to the current planning visit and is explicitly retired with its plan; no automatic persistence, outbound messages, account actions or venue contact are included.

### Existing owners and receiving

The Save/Open week continuation remains with `universal-0df473646168 / memory_capability`, following the integration and receiving handoffs on #4 (comments6059167993 and6059312581). Its active app/index spans and format remain owned there. The separate local-draft scope `estate-a4a1879c582f` and offline demo #14 retain their files. Current repository issues/PRs and central #140 topic claims were inspected before this additive scope; no existing contact-worksheet owner was found.

Implementation uses an isolated small source tree. Receiving will exercise original check provenance, literal user text, two occurrences at one venue, date/move/omit/restore behavior, accepted-new-plan and failed/abandoned-response retirement, keyboard/narrow-screen use and the actual print DOM through the existing app. Source integration follows independent review and current-source composition; no deployment or live Qloo/venue request is claimed.

completed_prs.title: Open native offline planner results as editable saved weeks
completed_prs.head: b9ac8ae18e76c635333056f3c9ff1c5caa1d43f5
completed_prs.body:
## Caregiver workflow

A successful native offline result can now become a file the regular TasteTable application's **Open saved week** action accepts. A caregiver can arrange the actual authored-profile suggestions, print the week, export its calendar, save the arrangement and reopen it without computing another plan.

```sh
python3 tastetable_cli.py --profile examples/native-profile.json > native-result.json && \
node tools/native_plan_to_week.mjs --input native-result.json --week 2026-10-08 --output my-week.json
```

Closes #25.

## Change and boundaries

The dependency-free converter calls the existing week model and saved-week writer. It validates the whole native envelope and five fixed provenance markers, preserves exact profile/response values in the existing v1 slots, and publishes only closed, complete bytes under a new filename. Invalid input, occupied names, input aliases and partial writes preserve existing data. If the final name was successfully created before cleanup or receipt delivery fails, the diagnostic explicitly reports that completed file.

The original envelope retains its outer provenance, which unchanged saved-week v1 cannot store. Marker checks validate format, not origin. Saved timestamps identify conversion, and each conversion gets a fresh calendar identity. The existing mock label, checks and explanations remain authoritative. This targets the regular application; #26's finite-record offline studio and #16's venue worksheet remain separate owner scopes.

Exact qualified head: **b9ac8ae18e76c635333056f3c9ff1c5caa1d43f5**; tree **2031698fbc8fcf94ad9af06117c2d9858bc83190**. Compared with main **d66ab91d62ba243cef2ba387cea73a684fa3b04e**, 278 inherited leaves retain exact blob, mode and type; only the native usage document changes, with six scoped additions. All existing planner, profile, sodium-check, fixture, browser, week-format, calendar and maintained CI source is unchanged.

## Actual receiving

Both jobs checked out **7bf9fe30167c393a111ee0fd51cdcd323ce9ddea**, whose directly read Git object has the qualified tree and parents **d66ab91d + b9ac8ae1**.

- [Maintained pytest CI](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/actions/runs/37786976828/job/113344118772): **153 passed; 150 subtests passed; no skips**, with one existing dependency deprecation warning, using Python 3.12.15. The frozen ten-method actual-command suite covers original producer output, exact native consumer admission, move/resave/calendar identity, Unicode/literal fields, complete-input bounds, dates, occupied/aliased paths and real POSIX partial-write cleanup. The separate post-publication cleanup control performs the real hard link, restricts its owned stage so native cleanup encounters kernel EACCES, receives the valid final file, checks the explicit created-file diagnostic and verifies a retry cannot replace it. Successful per-test stdout is captured by the maintained pytest invocation.
- [Browser receiving](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/actions/runs/37786977019/job/113344114986): **all 9 groups passed**, using existing cached Node **22.23.3**, system Chrome **154.0.8037.97** and system Python **3.12.3**, with no installs. Two actual original Python results pass through the converter; the real application file picker refuses the raw result and opens the converted file. Actual keyboard controls move/omit picks; real saved-week and calendar downloads preserve source and identity. The downloaded edited file reopens at **390px** with byte-identical calendar output. A no-match result remains an empty week.
- All **18 runtime source SHA-256 values** were compared with freshly fetched bytes at the published head and matched. The native report confirms no changed source/input files, runtime exceptions or planner/provider HTTP calls.

The browser serves unchanged application files with authored GET-only health/persona bootstrap responses; this is not an application-server deployment or live API qualification. The generated PDF and screenshots are preserved but **direct PDF text/pixel inspection is not claimed**.

## Preserved original phase

The test-only ancestor **366bd4e0d78983883859dacfea213b4614ed5dc5** keeps the original capability boundary. [Run 37784495321](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/actions/runs/37784495321/job/113335644662) checked out **a401c3f35833dfb03249551b95d6f8b5cee2aecb** and reported **35 failure records, 146 passes and 116 passed subtests**; all new failures identified the absent converter entrypoint. The raw native envelope's rejection by the existing saved-week reader already passed. This is an absent-capability control, not a defect claim against the original planner.

The original ten-method test remains Git blob **00a0bb1a32ab626f5588b97b8ca981a6aae4e930**, SHA-256 **dc1e65ff357672218799adf0152baf9d7041e2f15d74a1e9c9c614e3f87e964a**, with no changed inputs or assertions. The cleanup delivery correction arose in independent source review before candidate execution and has its own separate test.

## Evidence

[Bounded artifact 11555150706](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/actions/runs/37786977019/artifacts/11555150706) contains 15 actual input/output/PDF/PNG artifacts plus the report; ZIP size **387,186 bytes**, SHA-256 **1da42c5cc9029dd80b9a29ac9a3e210fc83cfc8a0d7c7285df0b547a96a6da09**, retention through 2026-10-22. The plain JSON report, individual hashes and all nine outcomes are also in the native job log.

Raw log SHA-256: maintained candidate **0ed7f2ed8f01b50179b02252802b3e569bc67134e7443da0814826f1c68ace2b**; browser candidate **e6303e7485ea6f44015ea40bd9bb8e719f47e049e16c7bef279cf40466e1f57c**; original absence **77aab215cc1fc37a618a1cdb6c6770b8bfd1a8717fded4ac9da336b87acc5093**.

The compact original-boundary receipt is committed beneath `docs/receiving/native-plan-week-7879c2abc07f/`. The source integration lead retains independent final acceptance and expected-head integration.

completed_prs.title: Do not label explicitly negated low-sodium keywords as positive
completed_prs.head: 93a5113ecdca863133b919dd4ecd731cca630846
completed_prs.body:
The native planner currently labels `no low sodium options` as positive evidence and repeats it beside a `Low sodium: pass` result. That denied cue also overrides an existing high-sodium signal in the retained offline plan reproduction.

This change excludes explicit local negations and unavailability of the existing positive cues. A denial alone follows the existing unknown outcome; an existing high cue can still produce a fail; separate affirmative evidence retains the existing positive-over-high precedence. Each occurrence is checked independently, so an unrelated negation or a later affirmative cue remains usable.

Only `check_low_sodium` and its dedicated helper change in the receiving composition; the existing standard-library `re` import is reused. The shared matcher, other constraint functions, strict/unknown policy, agent, fixtures, provider behavior and UI are unchanged. The separate wheelchair work in #20/#21 retains its ownership.

### Qualification

- The same nine-method native author suite changes from three passing controls and six failures on the original source to nine passes on the frozen candidate, with no errors or skips.
- The original three-method reproduction is retained separately: one pass and two failures become three passes, including the actual offline `FixtureTransport` → `QlooClient` → `ScriptedModel` → `run_agent` consumer path.
- Complete results for all three shipped synthetic personas remain byte-identical, including plans, explanations and traces.
- Independent four-method receiving changes from four baseline failures to four candidate passes, with its frozen source/test receipt and raw evidence included unchanged.
- The repository's unchanged full hosted pytest workflow passed on the actual PR merge composition: 142 tests and 116 subtests passed, with no failures, errors or skips and one Starlette TestClient deprecation warning. The original local stdlib receipts remain separately bound to their frozen source.

The scoped documentation and evidence preserve the original failures, actual plan output, source pins and candidate hashes. This is a software evidence-labeling correction over synthetic data; it does not add nutritional thresholds or establish a live-venue or health outcome.

### Current-parent composition

The source receives main `9930c0a18f339ca00bb7c43b4defd5b0d61ae56c`, including the completed native CLI and wheelchair PR #21. The composed classifier preserves the exact frozen low-sodium function/helper and every current wheelchair byte, with one existing `re` import. The 10-file packet is exact; all 269 unrelated parent leaves and their modes/types are preserved, with no deletions.

[Author qualification and composition](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/blob/93a5113ecdca863133b919dd4ecd731cca630846/docs/verification/low-sodium-evidence-20261008-e827/README.md) · [Independent receiving](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/blob/93a5113ecdca863133b919dd4ecd731cca630846/docs/verification/low-sodium-evidence-e82707f2bc62/independent-peer/README.md)

### Integrated result

Merged normally with expected head `93a5113ecdca863133b919dd4ecd731cca630846` as `d66ab91d62ba243cef2ba387cea73a684fa3b04e` on 2026-10-08 at 13:19:58 UTC. [Hosted CI run 37783201501, attempt 1](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/actions/runs/37783201501) tested checkout `08bbe61cb7d41460d2521fc1fc9e701cf0547674`; its tree `e5c3f77b0263d8bc1379a99cab591e2194231f49` is exactly the final merge and main tree. Final readback confirms all 279 leaves, all 10 packet files, all 269 unrelated current-parent leaves and their modes/types, with no file deletions. Issue #22 closed through this integration.

The hosted workflow provides its checkout SHA and full pytest result; it does not emit a separate source-worktree fingerprint or JUnit artifact. This receipt claims source and native-test integration only.

Closes #22.

completed_prs.title: Require affirmative wheelchair entrance evidence
completed_prs.head: 4ba587e0ee5fa24558fa5dbc948cfedd26613c44
completed_prs.body:
A tag mentioning a wheelchair can describe a rental service, a partial facility or a denial of access. The previous check treated all such mentions as proof of an accessible entrance. Three authored response variants each reached the actual planner as five checked picks with that affirmative explanation.

This change requires the existing full affirmative entrance label, or the known local fixture identifier when unlabelled. Mixed unresolved access claims remain UNKNOWN under the existing strict exclusion. The steps refusal still wins, and an unrelated rental tag can coexist with separate established entrance evidence.

## Exact scope

Only `constraints.py::check_wheelchair` changes in production, plus `tests/test_wheelchair_evidence.py`. The provider, planner, dietary checks, fixture/persona content, UI, calendar and request lifecycle are unchanged.

[Source pins and original/final receiving](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/blob/4ba587e0ee5fa24558fa5dbc948cfedd26613c44/docs/receiving/wheelchair-evidence-20261008-3dcb83a1/README.md).
